description.en: A bilingual Next.js showcase concept shaped for brands that need a fast first impression, clear messaging, and an easy handoff into content operations.
description.tr: Hizli bir ilk izlenim, net mesajlasma ve icerik operasyonlarina kolay devir isteyen markalar icin tasarlanmis cift dilli bir Next.js vitrin kurgusu.

longDescription.en: This seed case study highlights Applyron's approach to reusable sections, production-minded front-end structure, and launch-ready presentation without unnecessary complexity.
longDescription.tr: Bu seed case study, Applyron'un tekrar kullanilabilir bolumler, production odakli on yuz yapisi ve gereksiz karmasiklik olmadan lansmana hazir sunum yaklasimini gosterir.

description.en: An interactive card-based experience designed to help brands present services, highlights, and campaign stories in a more engaging way.
description.tr: Markalarin hizmetlerini, one cikan yonlerini ve kampanya hikayelerini daha etkileyici bir sekilde sunmasi icin tasarlanmis kart tabanli etkilesimli bir deneyim.

longDescription.en: The concept focuses on motion, modular storytelling, and flexible front-end composition so content can feel premium without depending on a heavy CMS stack.
longDescription.tr: Bu konsept; hareket, moduler hikaye anlatimi ve esnek on yuz kurgusuna odaklanir; boylece icerik, agir bir CMS kurgusuna bagli kalmadan premium hissettirir.

description.en: A visually immersive concept for brands that want a bold landing experience with depth, motion, and a more atmospheric storytelling layer.
description.tr: Derinlik, hareket ve daha atmosferik bir hikaye anlatimi katmani isteyen markalar icin hazirlanmis gorsel olarak surukleyici bir landing experience kurgusu.

longDescription.en: The seed project demonstrates how cinematic visuals and modern front-end tooling can support a distinctive brand presentation without sacrificing clarity.
longDescription.tr: Bu seed proje, sinematik gorseller ile modern on yuz araclarinin netlikten odun vermeden ayirt edici bir marka sunumunu nasil destekleyebilecegini gosterir.
